title: A live campaign doesn't pull in contacts added to its segment after launch
hypothesis: Contacts added to a launched campaign's segment would flow into it.
change: Kept adding contacts to the segment after the campaign went live.
result: The campaign stayed at 18 leads while its segment grew to 53.
next_decision: Finish the segment, then launch; add later contacts as a new campaign.
check: Count a live campaign's enrolled leads against its segment before reporting reach; contacts added after launch need a new campaign.
